items.q: A liquid has a density of 720 kg/m3. What is its specific gravity?
Calculate the gauge pressure at a depth of 2 m in water, in kN/m2.
A body displaces 2.5 m3 of water. Calculate the upthrust on it in kN.
items.s: Upthrust = rho g V = 1000 x 9.81 x 2.5 = 24.52 kN.

items.q: Water flows at 0.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 200 mm. Find the discharge in litres per second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 2.5 m. Find the theoretical velocity of the jet in m/s.
items.s: V = sqrt(2gh) = sqrt(2 x 9.81 x 2.5) = 7 m/s.

items.q: A liquid of density 860 kg/m3. Calculate its specific weight in kN/m3.
items.s: Specific weight = rho g = 860 x 9.81 = 8436.6 N/m3 = 8.44 kN/m3.

items.q: A thin film 0.5 mm thick between two plates of area 0.5 m2 moves with velocity 1.0 m/s under a force of 5 N. Find the dynamic viscosity in N s/m2.
items.s: Shear stress = F/A = 5/0.5 = 10.0 N/m2; viscosity = tau x t/V = 10.0 x 0.0005/1.0 = 0.005 N s/m2.

items.q: For a liquid of dynamic viscosity 0.002 N s/m2 and density 1000 kg/m3, calculate the kinematic viscosity in m2/s.
items.s: Kinematic viscosity = mu/rho = 0.002/1000 = 0.000002 m2/s.

items.q: Water of surface tension 0.0728 N/m rises in a clean glass tube of radius 0.3 mm with zero contact angle. Find the capillary rise in mm.
At what depth in water is the gauge pressure 19.62 kN/m2?
A rectangular gate 1.2 m wide and 2.5 m high has its top edge at the water surface. Find the total force on it in kN.
A vertical rectangular gate 2.4 m high has its upper edge at the water surface. At what depth below the surface does the total force act, in m?
items.s: Centre of pressure = 2H/3 = 2 x 2.4/3 = 1.6 m below the surface.

items.q: A U tube manometer reads 150 mm of mercury. Calculate the pressure in kN/m2.
A piezometer shows a column of 500 mm of liquid of specific gravity 0.8. What pressure does this represent, in kN/m2?
A solid block of specific gravity 0.65 floats in water. What fraction of its volume is submerged?
items.s: For a floating body the submerged fraction equals its specific gravity = 0.65.

items.q: A block of mass 800 kg floats in fresh water. What volume of water does it displace, in m3?
items.s: Buoyant force equals weight: V = m/rho = 800/1000 = 0.8 m3.

items.q: A rectangular pontoon 6 m wide floats with a draft of 1.2 m. Calculate its metacentric radius BM in m.
A floating body has BM = 2.5 m and BG = 1 m. Find its metacentric height in m.
items.s: GM = BM - BG = 2.5 - 1 = 1.5 m, so the body is stable because GM is positive.

items.q: A pipe of diameter 250 mm carries 30 litres per second. Calculate the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows from a pipe of diameter 200 mm into one of diameter 125 mm at 2.5 m/s. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe in m/s.
Oil of density 900 kg/m3 flows at 2 m/s through a 100 mm pipe. Find the mass flow rate in kg/s.
items.s: Area = 0.00785 m2; mass rate = rho A V = 900 x 0.00785 x 2 = 14.14 kg/s.

items.q: Water flows at 0.8 m/s in a 75 mm pipe with dynamic viscosity 0.0012 N s/m2. Calculate the Reynolds number.
items.s: Re = rho V d/mu = 1000 x 0.8 x 0.075/0.0012 = 50000, which is turbulent because it exceeds 4000.

items.q: A pressure of 50 kN/m2 acts in a water main. What head of water does it represent, in m?
items.s: h = p/(rho g) = 50000/9810 = 5.1 m of water.

items.q: A pump delivers 0.08 m3/s of water against a total head of 15 m. Find the water power in kW.
Water flows along a horizontal pipe where the pressure falls by 39 kN/m2 between two sections. Neglecting losses, find the increase in velocity in m/s.
items.s: By Bernoulli, v2^2/2g - v1^2/2g = dP/(rho g) = 4 m, so the velocity increase is sqrt(2 x 9.81 x 4) = 8.86 m/s.

The actual velocity of a jet from an orifice under 2 m head is 4.2 m/s. Find the coefficient of velocity.
items.s: Theoretical velocity = sqrt(2 x 9.81 x 2) = 6.264 m/s; Cv = V/theoretical = 0.6705.

the line joining the piezometric heads along a pipeline
